question: Who among the following was the Secretary of State of India and a member of the Cabinet Mission sent to India by the British Government in 1946?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Lord Pethick-Lawrence**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lord Pethick-Lawrence** was the **Secretary of State for India** at the time the **Cabinet Mission** was sent to India in **1946**.
 
• The **Cabinet Mission** was sent by the **British Government** to discuss the transfer of power from British rule to Indian leadership and to formulate a framework for the **Indian Constitution**.
 
• Lord Pethick-Lawrence was one of the three members of the **Cabinet Mission**
